comment: Settings for ./with-secrets, which runs ./pubkit secrets run (pubkit's README, "Services", explains each). project: the Bitwarden Secrets Manager project to read. Here it feeds the deploy walk, `./with-secrets ./pubkit deploy walk --fulfil` (notifier-reader-key, slack-bot-token), and `./with-secrets ./pubkit app-secrets`, which sends the values pubkit.json's secrets list names to this repository.
